test_title: PYST 57: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I: **All drums are guitars.

**Statement II: **All guitars are flutes.

**Statement III: **All flutes are sitars.

**Conclusion I: **Some drums are sitars.

**Conclusion II**: All sitars are guitars.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1eb346b5b5378f32cea0b03da548d27caf5dbdd7881f1754575f447374ff81f.png] 

Conclusion I: Some drums are sitars -** True** (all drum is guitar, all guitar is flute and all flute is sitar, so all part of drum is in sitar, **so conclusion follows)**

Conclusion II: All sitars are guitars -** False** (As it is already mentioned in the statement all flute is sitar and all part of guitar is in flute, **so the conclusion dose not follows**)

So, only statement 1 is true

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
